correctness.rationale: For explicitly labeled C=L(Q3), exhaustive perfect-matching enumeration lists 32 facets and all 1,428 nonempty faces. The included exact certificate enumerates and individually validates 692 acyclic face–coface pairs, with precisely one critical vertex and 43 critical two-cells. All 4,968 face incidences are oriented and topologically sorted without a cycle. Forman discrete Morse theory yields a CW complex with one zero-cell and 43 two-cells, hence an integral bouquet of 43 two-spheres. Independently computed mod-two ranks (23,169,308,160,32) and Euler characteristic 44 agree; the integral conclusion relies on the acyclic matching, not on finite sampling.

value.rationale: The exact homotopy type is a complete natural invariant of the perfect-matching-extendability complex on the classical cuboctahedral graph, not a hand-picked slice. Despite being pure 5-dimensional with 32 facets, the complex has all its reduced homotopy type in degree 2, in sharp contrast with the ordinary matching complex on the same graph (57 three-spheres). That distinction is motivated by the structural question of which matchings extend to a perfect one. No downstream theorem is assumed.
